parameters.help_en:
The database instance IDs.

Set this parameter to a JSON array that consists of multiple instance IDs. Separate instance IDs with commas (,). Example: `['Instance ID1', 'Instance ID2']`
parameters.help_zh:
数据库实例ID。

数据格式为JSONArray，例如`['实例ID1','实例ID2']`，实例ID间用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en: The threshold for CPU utilization. Valid values: 70% to 100%
parameters.name: cpu_usage

parameters.help_en:
The logical relationship between the CPU utilization threshold and the maximum number of active sessions. Valid values:

AND

OR
parameters.help_zh:
CPU利用率阈值和活跃会话数阈值的逻辑关系。
AND：且。
OR：或
parameters.name: cpu_session_relation

parameters.help_en:
The threshold for the number of active sessions.

If this parameter and CpuUsage are in the OR relationship, set this parameter to an integer that is greater than or equal to 16.

If this parameter and CpuUsage are in the AND relationship, set this parameter to an integer that is greater than or equal to 2
parameters.help_zh:
活跃会话数阈值。

与CPU利用率阈值关系为OR（或）时，大于等于16。
与CPU利用率阈值关系为AND（且）时，大于等于2
parameters.name: active_sessions

parameters.help_en: The duration threshold for triggering automatic SQL throttling. Set this parameter to an integer that is greater than or equal to 2. Unit: minutes
parameters.help_zh: 触发自动SQL限流的异常的持续时间阈值，取值范围：大于等于2的正整数，单位：分钟
parameters.name: abnormal_duration

parameters.help_en: The maximum throttling duration. Set this parameter to a positive integer. Unit: minutes
parameters.help_zh: 最大限流时长，取值为正整数，单位：分钟
parameters.name: max_throttle_time

parameters.help_en: The start time of the throttling window. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 可限流时间段的开始时间（UTC时间）
parameters.name: allow_throttle_start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the throttling window. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 可限流时间段的结束时间（UTC时间）
parameters.name: allow_throttle_end_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to terminate abnormal SQL statements in execution at the same time. Valid values:

Abnormal SQL statements use the same template as the SQL statements to be throttled.

true

false
parameters.help_zh:
是否同时KILL执行中的异常SQL：
异常SQL：与需要限流的SQL模板相同。

true：是。
false：否
parameters.name: auto_kill_session

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the asynchronous request.

You can leave this parameter empty when you call the operation to initiate the request for the first time, and use the value of this parameter contained in the response to the first request for subsequent requests
parameters.help_zh:
异步请求的ID。
异步调用后不会立即返回完整结果，首先需要调用该接口获取ResultId，然后使用返回数据的ResultId，重新发起调用，直到isFinish取值为true时，返回完整结果。即获取一次完整数据，至少需要调用该接口两次
parameters.name: result_id
